title: OpenCode Zellij Configuration
description: Configuration schema for the opencode-zellij plugin

$schema.description: JSON schema reference for IDE autocompletion

auto_rename_tabs.description: Whether to automatically rename tabs with todo progress (e.g., 'Tab (2/5)'). Set to false to disable tab renaming.

plugin_path.description: Custom path to the WASM plugin. Usually not needed - the bundled plugin is used by default.
